speaker: A
name: Alex
text: It used to be good, because there was a subway station right near my home — I could just take the subway anywhere.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: But I recently moved to another place, and the transport has become much worse.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Now I'm in a remote area: I have to take a bus first, then transfer to the subway station, and only then take the subway into the city.
